headline: Figaro Culinary opens P1-B tender offer
summary: Figaro Coffee Systems, a 99.94%-owned subsidiary of Figaro Culinary, opened a tender offer at P0.82 per share in cash. The offer is part of the restaurant operator's planned voluntary delisting from the Philippine Stock Exchange.
why: Voluntary delistings remove a company's shares from public trading, which affects minority shareholders and how investors can access the stock.
